item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-09-10 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 9 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (3). Google has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2025-14733 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 836 positions.
